jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bolna

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don't have to.

We're a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast. Our team of ~25 is based in Bengaluru.

The Role

You're the person who makes our voice agents actually sound good and actually work for real customers. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of our product and our customers. Your primary job is to design, write, and iterate on the prompts and tools that power Bolna's voice agents, making them smarter, more natural, and more effective for each use case.

You'll work closely with customers to understand their goals, build agent flows, test conversations, and fix what breaks. No heavy coding required-if you can vibe-code a basic script or write a solid system prompt, you're qualified.

What You'll Do

  • Write, test, and iterate on system prompts for voice agents across industries like D2C, fintech, healthcare, and logistics

  • Listen to real call recordings, identify where agents fail, and fix them

  • Build conversation flows and call pathways for new customer deployments

  • Help onboard new customers-understand their use case, set up their agent, and get it live

  • Maintain a growing library of prompts, templates, and best practices across Bolna's verticals

  • Red-team agents-try to break them, find edge cases, and make them bulletproof

  • Work with vernacular inputs: test agents in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages

  • Feed insights back to product and engineering-you'll see what customers need before anyone else does

What We're Looking For

Must-have:

  • You've spent serious time prompting ChatGPT, Claude, or similar LLMs-not just casually, but to actually build or solve something

  • You're obsessive about language-you notice when a sentence sounds off, robotic, or unclear

  • You can think from the customer's perspective and the end-user's perspective at the same time

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make decisions without a full playbook

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English. Hindi or any other Indian language is a big plus

Good to have:

  • You've tinkered with voice AI tools-Bolna, Vapi, ElevenLabs, or similar

  • You've vibe-coded something: a small automation, a chatbot, a no-code workflow-anything

  • Experience in a customer-facing role, even informally (sales, support, intern, freelance)

  • Familiarity with how LLMs work under the hood-context windows, temperature, hallucination, etc.

Why Bolna

  • The hottest team in the hottest market in India right now

  • Freshers who joined 3 months back are single-handedly working with CXOs and Senior PMs of massive enterprises

  • Direct access to founders and product-your work will visibily ship

  • You'll develop a rare, high-value skill set at the intersection of AI, product, and customer success

  • Competitive compensation for early-career profiles

  • Bengaluru office, in-person team collaboration

jobs.title: Conversation Quality Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bolna

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India - and now for the world. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don’t have to.

We’re a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast. Our team of ~25 is based in Bengaluru.

The Role

Every voice AI agent Bolna deploys makes real-time judgment calls - when to speak, when to go silent, when a customer is done talking, when to hand off. We’re building automated systems to grade these calls at scale, using LLMs as judges of call quality. But before you trust a model’s judgment, you verify it against a human’s.

That’s this role. You’ll listen to real calls, annotate what actually happened, and check whether our automated systems - LLM-as-judge evals and quantitative signal detection - got it right. It’s precise, high-attention work, and it sits right at the center of how we know our voice agents are actually working.

This is an internship role for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to how a voice AI company builds trust in its own AI.



What You’ll Do

Annotation

  • Listen to and annotate real customer calls - transcription review, issue tagging, labeling - using tools like Label Studio

  • Follow (and help sharpen) annotation guidelines for a multilingual environment (Hindi, English, Hinglish, )

Verifying LLM-as-Judge Evaluations

  • For calls flagged by our automated eval pipeline, verify whether the model’s call was actually correct - for example, confirming whether a detected barge-in (agent/customer talking over each other) genuinely happened by listening to the audio

  • Mark agreements and disagreements clearly, with reasoning, so we can measure and improve model accuracy over time

  • All tools needed for this will be provided

Verifying Quantitative Measures

  • Check system-flagged quantitative signals against the actual call - e.g., confirming whether an “agent interruption” the system detected really occurred at that timestamp

  • Flag false positives/negatives so we can tighten detection logic

  • Help identify edge cases that current rubrics or detection logic don’t handle well


Inspecting Calls & Surfacing New Issues

  • Regularly inspect calls beyond flagged ones to spot new or emerging issues our rubrics and detection systems don't yet cover

  • Bring these patterns back to the team so rubrics, prompts, and detection logic keep improving

What We’re Looking For

Must-have

  • Strong attention to detail and the patience to do focused, high-precision work across many calls

  • Multilingual comfort preferred - Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, or Bengali, in addition to English/Hindi

  • Comfortable learning new tools quickly - Label Studio, dashboards, internal QA apps

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and voice AI - you want to understand why a call was flagged, not just complete a checklist

Good to have

  • Any prior exposure to data annotation, labeling, or QA work

  • Familiarity with spreadsheets/basic SQL or comfort reading dashboards (e.g., Metabase)

  • Background in linguistics, call center operations, or content moderation


How This Role Grows

This is designed as an entry point, not an endpoint. Based on where you show strength, we’ll shape what comes next:

  • Strong rigor and consistency in annotation → QA Lead / Annotation Lead

  • Curiosity about agent logic and how voice AI actually works → Forward Deployed Engineer track

  • Strong pattern recognition and rubric thinking → Data/Eval Engineer, Voice AI Analyst

We’ve seen people join in QA and grow into much broader voice AI builder roles - this is meant to be a real foot in the door, not a dead-end task.


Why Bolna

  • Direct exposure to how a fast-growing AI infra company builds trust in its own models

  • Real ownership over a function (call quality) that directly affects what customers see

  • Fastest way to learn the guts of voice AI - ASR, agent logic, eval pipelines - from the ground up

  • Bengaluru office, in-person team collaboration

jobs.title: Enterprise Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bolna

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India - and now for the world. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don’t have to.

We’re a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast.



This Role

As an Enterprise Lead, you will own the success of Bolna’s largest and most strategic enterprise deployments.

You will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), ensuring enterprise customers move from business problem → deployment → measurable outcomes. You’ll work closely with CXOs and senior stakeholders on the customer side while partnering with Bolna’s Product, Engineering, and Business teams internally.

This is a high-ownership role. You will be expected to bring structure to complex enterprise problems, drive execution through your team, and ensure that deployments are not just launched - but successful.

You’ll operate at the intersection of enterprise delivery, customer success, technology, and business.



What You’ll Do

  • Lead and manage a team of FDEs, setting clear priorities, driving execution, and maintaining a high bar for customer delivery.

  • Own the end-to-end success of strategic enterprise deployments - from scoping and solution design to launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Work directly with enterprise stakeholders and CXOs to understand business objectives, define success metrics, and communicate progress.

  • Translate complex business requirements into clear execution plans across FDE, Product, and Engineering teams.

  • Review deployment strategies, solution architecture, agent performance, and customer outcomes to ensure quality and scalability.

  • Identify risks and bottlenecks early and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution.

  • Build repeatable enterprise deployment playbooks, processes, and best practices.

  • Analyze customer and deployment data to identify patterns, improve outcomes, and make informed decisions.

  • Present deployment plans, business cases, performance reviews, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Partner with Sales and Business teams on enterprise opportunities, solutioning, pilots, and expansion conversations.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for critical enterprise accounts.

  • Develop the FDE team through regular feedback, coaching, and high-quality problem-solving standards.

  • Bring customer insights back to Product and Engineering to influence product priorities and platform improvements.



What We’re Looking For

Must-have

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, B2B enterprise deployments, enterprise SaaS, or a fast-growing startup.

  • Strong preference for candidates with prior corporate/enterprise experience and exposure to complex stakeholder environments.

  • Experience leading teams and driving execution through others.

  • Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, executable plans.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills - comfortable presenting to CXOs and senior enterprise stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability; you can work with data to understand what is happening and why.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to operate across business, technology, and customer-facing teams without needing a predefined playbook.

  • High ownership and bias towards execution - you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.


Good to Have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, or technology deployments.

  • Experience managing or mentoring FDEs, consultants, solution engineers, implementation teams, or customer success teams.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and complex deployment environments.

  • Exposure to enterprise sales, solution consulting, or pre-sales.

  • Experience building processes or playbooks from scratch.

  • Consulting experience from a top-tier consulting firm is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Enterprise deployments launch on time and with high quality.

  • Customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their Bolna deployments.

  • FDEs operate with increasing ownership, speed, and technical/business depth.

  • Enterprise escalations are resolved quickly and systematically.

  • Deployment processes become increasingly repeatable and scalable.

  • Customer insights translate into meaningful improvements across Product and Engineering.

  • Strategic enterprise accounts expand because of the outcomes delivered.



Why Bolna

  • Work directly with some of India’s largest enterprises and solve high-impact business problems.

  • Lead a team operating at the intersection of AI, technology, and enterprise business.

  • High ownership and visibility - your work directly impacts customer outcomes and company growth.

  • Work closely with founders and senior leadership on strategic enterprise initiatives.

  • Build the playbook for deploying Voice AI at enterprise scale.

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful ESOPs.

  • Delhi office with a highly collaborative, in-person working environment.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales (BFSI)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bolna

Bolna is building the voice infrastructure for India, powering millions of AI-powered conversations for businesses across BFSI, e-commerce, logistics, and more.

About the role

You will own new-logo sales into Banks, NBFCs, Insurers and Fintechs for Bolna's Voice AI products: voice agents, workflows and analytics.

This is a hunter role. You will find the accounts, build the relationships, create the pipeline and see deals through a long BFSI sales cycle, working directly with the Lead, GTM & Sales. It suits someone who has sold software to BFSI buyers, enjoys early-stage ambiguity and wants high ownership.

Key responsibilities :

The core of the role is finding new BFSI accounts and turning them into a steady, qualified pipeline.

  • Account scouting: identify and prioritise new BFSI accounts (banks, NBFCs, insurers, fintechs) and map the right decision-makers

  • Pipeline creation: build a lead pipeline from scratch through networking, cold outreach, referrals and industry events

  • Relationship building: develop and nurture client relationships through consistent engagement, meetings and follow-ups across a long sales cycle

  • Lead follow-up: qualify inbound and outbound leads and follow up persistently so no opportunity goes cold

  • Full-cycle selling: understand client requirements in depth, run product demos of Bolna's voice agents, workflows and analytics, negotiate pricing and close deals

  • Internal collaboration: work with Business, Product and Marketing teams to understand the product deeply, pass client feedback and requirements back, and plan events that showcase Bolna's solutions

  • Market research: track BFSI trends, new categories and product gaps, and monitor competitors' solutions, strategy and pricing

Requirements :

Candidates must have 2–3 years of B2B sales experience in SaaS or Voice AI, with BFSI clients as their core market.

  • 2–3 years of experience selling B2B SaaS or Voice AI products to BFSI clients (banks, NBFCs, insurance, fintech)

  • Proven track record of sourcing new accounts and building pipeline, not only managing existing ones

  • Hands-on experience across the sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, demos, pricing negotiation and closure

  • Ability to understand client requirements and deliver clear, credible product demos

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Skill at building and sustaining relationships through a long, multi-stakeholder BFSI sales cycle

  • Demonstrated high ownership in previous roles

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment

Good to have

  • Prior startup experience

  • Existing network among BFSI decision-makers (CXOs, heads of operations, collections, customer experience, digital or contact centre)

Why Bolna

  • The hottest team in the hottest market in India right now

  • Working with CXOs and Senior PMs of massive enterprises

  • Direct access to founders and product-your work to sell

  • You'll develop a rare, high-value skill set at the intersection of AI, product, and customer success

  • Competitive compensation for early-career profiles

  • Bengaluru office, in-person team collaboration

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Bolna (YC-backed) is building the voice infrastructure for India, powering millions of AI-powered conversations for businesses across industries.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Bolna

Bolna is Voice AI infrastructure built for India, and now for the world. We help businesses deploy intelligent voice agents that can call, converse, and convert in any language, at scale. From collections to customer support to sales, our agents handle millions of conversations so humans don't have to.

We're a YC F25 company, backed by General Catalyst, with 1,050+ paying customers and growing fast. Our team of 70+ is based in Bengaluru.


The Role

Bolna's voice agents handle millions of real conversations for some of India's largest enterprises. Every one of those calls has to sound natural, and when one goes wrong, we need to know why, fast.

As a Product Manager, you'll own two areas: how the call sounds and feels to the person on the other end, and how we, our FDEs and our customers know whether an agent is working and why it isn't. You'll decide which problems matter most, define what "better" means, and ship improvements that work for every customer, not just one. This role is for someone who has done this before: you'll set the direction for both areas, not execute a roadmap someone else wrote.

You'll work with the founders and the engineering, ML and FDE teams, sometimes on your own and sometimes alongside another PM or an engineering lead. It's a hands-on role: you'll write the spec, and often the first SQL query, prompt or prototype too.



What You'll Do

In-call experience

  • Own the quality of the live conversation: background noise and noise cancellation, turn-taking and interruptions, latency, and language switching.

  • Drive agent memory: context that carries across calls, between steps of a multi-step agent, and through agent-to-agent transfers.

  • Work with ML engineers on model choices and the models we build. Define what "better" means, build the eval set, and decide when an in-house model is ready to replace a vendor.

  • Turn fuzzy complaints from FDEs and customers ("the agent sounds off", "it keeps cutting people off") into metrics with clear thresholds.

Observability

  • Make it fast to find out why a call went wrong: which turn, which component (telephony, speech recognition, LLM, voice, tools), and what to change.

  • Shape the dashboards, call-level debugging views and automated evals, including LLM-as-judge, that FDEs and customers use every day.

  • Define the handful of quality and reliability metrics the company watches, and own their accuracy.

  • Spot recurring failure patterns across thousands of calls before customers report them.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • 4+ years in product management, or in an engineering, consulting, analytics or founding role where you owned what got built and why. You've shipped products that moved a metric you can name.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person. A one-page problem statement from you gets engineers, FDEs and customers on the same page.

  • You're a driver with high ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not tickets, and follow up until the fix works in production.

  • You're comfortable handling many small problems in a week and one hard problem over a quarter.

  • You can work independently, and you also work well alongside other PMs and engineering leads.

Preferred

  • Problem solving. You break messy, ambiguous problems into clear parts, find the root cause, and pick the simplest fix that works.

  • Data sense. You go to the data before forming a view. You write your own SQL, can tell a real pattern from noise, and notice when a number looks wrong and work out why.

  • Technical understanding. You know how systems fit together and can reason about LLMs, APIs, latency and trade-offs. You read logs and API docs and hold your own in design discussions with engineers. You don't need to write production code.

Good-to-have

  • Experience with voice AI, conversational AI, LLM products, or developer and infrastructure platforms.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: prompting, evals, LLM-as-judge, or prototypes you vibe-coded yourself.

  • Exposure to speech technology: speech recognition, text-to-speech, noise suppression, or telephony.

  • You've worked closely with enterprise customers or with forward-deployed or solutions teams.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, success means:

  • Callers on our largest deployments have measurably better conversations, tracked on metrics you defined.

  • FDEs and customers can work out why a call went wrong in minutes, without pulling in engineering.

  • Recurring call failures are caught before customers report them.

  • Every in-call change ships with a metric, so we know whether it worked in production.

  • You own the roadmap for both areas, so engineering time goes to the problems that matter most to customers, and everyone can see why.

Why Bolna

  • One of the fastest-moving teams in Voice AI in India

  • Your problems come straight from live deployments at some of India's largest enterprises, and your fixes reach millions of calls

  • Direct access to the founders, and daily work with engineering, ML and FDEs

  • Build a rare skill set at the intersection of AI, speech, product and enterprise

  • Competitive compensation + meaningful ESOPs

  • Bengaluru office, in-person team collaboration
